document: 研究/04_共同可靠性/README.md#9-第三步建议怎样推进八个子步骤与验收关卡

steps.planned_evidence: Evidence-based assumption ledger, separate facts/theory/untestable assumptions; retain target scope and unavailable states

steps.task: 条件均值与联合依赖机制
steps.planned_evidence: Explicit stochastic/conditioning regime, heterogeneous mean and dependence restrictions; no silent estimand change

steps.task: 候选筛选及理论对应链
steps.planned_evidence: Parameter mapping, theorem/version/conditions and separate covariance-estimation/distributional arguments
Specified scenarios/truth/methods/performance/MC precision/failure and stopping rules; development separated from locked validation
Independent tiny joint binary examples, role/overlap/degeneracy/numerical checks, no inherited inference acceptance from design tests

steps.task: 实际模拟与组合压力检验
steps.planned_evidence: Valid binary generators, true conditional/marginal probabilities, shared Y across targets, real-design and compatible growth-series evaluation
Coverage/error-control first, then precision/stability/cost; retain failures and constrain full-family claims

steps.task: 方法论证归档与第四步交接
steps.planned_evidence: Traceable goal-assumption-theory-implementation-simulation-scope explanation; real-data CIs and sensitivity remain step4

source_framework: Q4-P08: ADEMP; simulation-design guidance only, not an accepted football estimator
limits: A workflow and paper reading do not establish theorem fit, variance identification or confidence coverage. Eight future deliverables are planned, not existing artifacts.
